title: Rip My Granny
blurb: Dark humour delivered with the timing of somebody who has thought carefully about the pause. The clip belongs to a long meme tradition of processing grief through absolute nonsense, which is either extremely healthy or a matter for a professional, depending entirely on who you ask. What makes it land is the confidence — there is no hedging, no apologetic laugh, just a statement made and left standing. The internet found it funny, as the internet reliably does with anything nobody is quite comfortable admitting they laughed at.
